geeklist.title: FINAL 24 HOURS - Don't Be a Grinch; Buy My Games Auction - US Only, Ships from 94954 (ends 07Dec2025)
geeklist.description:
[size=18][b]It's the holiday season and your friends/family want some new or gently used games as gifts this year. Don't be a grinch! Buy some games from me![/b][/size]
[size=18][b]Rules: Please read before bidding[/b][/size]
:d10-1: All bids must be in $1 increments. Items have a starting bid (SB) price and a BIN (Buy It Now) price. If someone BINs the item, bidding is closed.[b] [size=18]I will not accept bids below the SB price.[/size][/b]
:d10-2: Auction is U.S. only and currency is in USD. Winning bidders will be contacted via geekmail; all sales will go through the Marketplace so BGG will receive its commission. All payments will be made through PayPal. I can also accept Venmo. Contact me if you want to inquire about a different payment method.
:d10-3: I ship using PirateShip.com so you can get a shipping estimate there.
:d10-4: All games are complete and in excellent/like new condition unless otherwise noted. Games might show some minor shelf wear. All games come from a smoke-free home and are stored inside the house (no moisture or mold).
:d10-5: Local pickup/meetups are available within 20 min of Petaluma, CA. Shipping is from 94954 (Petaluma, CA).
:d10-6: Please don't delete bids without contacting me first.
:d10-7:[b] NOTE: If you bid on an item, please be prepared to follow through with payment within three days of auction close.[/b]
:d10-8: Auction will end on Saturday [b]07Dec2025[/b] at approximately 8:00pm PST
